data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest editorial product image
Input images: Image 1 is the exact product identity and geometry reference. Preserve the product faithfully.
Primary request: create a deadpan, high-taste editorial portrait in the spirit of the cat spa appointment, showing the exact red Lick'em mouth-held tongue-shaped cat brush in unmistakable, gentle use. No written title or text appears in the image. The click reason is the surprising discovery that the elegant grooming scene uses a real absurd mouth brush.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet, sunlit home dressing area with one vintage upholstered chair, warm plaster wall, and minimal natural textures; it should feel like an independent interiors magazine, not a commercial set.
Subject: one naturally styled adult kneels beside one calm long-haired domestic cat sitting upright on the chair. Show the adult in three-quarter side profile holding the exact red plastic mouth tray between closed lips/teeth. One single broad red tongue-shaped flap curves down from the tray; its underside has many short, evenly spaced, blunt red conical grooming pegs like the reference. The lower rows of pegs visibly sink a few millimeters into the cat's shoulder fur in one clear contact patch. The brush is hard red plastic and roughly 4.5 inches long. The cat looks relaxed and comfortable.
Style/medium: photorealistic European editorial portrait, candid and restrained, real skin, hair, wool upholstery and fur texture, subtle analog grain, gentle imperfection.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3; medium portrait showing the full relationship among face, complete brush, and cat; product centered in the visual triangle and fully readable; one person and one cat only; no product pack shot or text overlay.
Lighting/mood: calm late-afternoon window light, muted cream and tobacco palette, vivid red brush as the one visual interruption; composed, sincere, slightly absurd.
Constraints: exact product geometry and function; one brush only; mouth tray visibly connected to the tongue-shaped flap; underside peg rows clearly visible and making believable contact with fur; normal human mouth and face; anatomically correct cat; ordinary product scale; physically credible shadows; no brand logo or packaging; no embedded copy; no CTA; no border; no collage; no watermark.
Avoid: human tongue, flesh-colored tongue, licking, tongue emerging directly from mouth, cat distress, product hovering above fur, duplicated lips/teeth/limbs/ears, extra people or cats, extra brush, malformed pegs, overlong or flexible tongue, promotional ad layout, studio product shot, discount graphic, template structure, over-retouching.
data.changesFromParent: A deliberately wider, dead-serious cat-spa ritual rather than the intimate reading-nook close-up.
notes: Generated separately as a distinct execution.
The repository copy was inspected at full useful resolution.
